from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545741/attempts/24c6b32aa5ef47bea0ad877ddcf721da/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    for row in out:
        colored = [i for i, value in enumerate(row) if value != background]
        if colored:
            for i in range(colored[-1] + 1, len(row)):
                row[i] = 1
    return out
'''
p=base/'task-1d139450.py'
p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(p),'exec'))

def mk(h,w,bg, rows):
    g=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r, vals in rows.items():

    return g
